hypothesis: Biotic composition similarity among regions is not predicted by climatic similarity.
pass_criterion: Partial Mantel correlation between climate distance and biotic dissimilarity among regions, controlling for geographic distance, is below 0.2, with matched-climate regions (e.g. 25-35S in Australia, South Africa, South America) having Sorensen turnover above 0.9.
fail_criterion: The partial Mantel correlation is at least 0.4, or matched-climate regions share more than 30% of genera.
interpretation: Needs paired climate and biota data in one dataset. No single one was fetched.
no_dataset_reason: No single fetched public dataset pairs regional biota composition with climate surfaces.
